summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1 and verified persistence across reboot. Existing contents were preserved.
actions_performed: Created system group inventory-readers and non-login system user inventorysvc.
Set all existing inventory content ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers.
Set directories to 0750 and files to 0640.
Verified owner and reader-group access while unrelated users are denied.
Rebooted node1 once and verified the changed boot identity and recovered permissions/data.

evidence.summary: Pre-change and post-restart SHA-256 hashes match for config.json and records.csv.

evidence.requirement: Owned by inventorysvc and readable by inventory-readers
evidence.summary: Confirms persistent identities, inventorysvc:inventory-readers ownership, 0750 directories, 0640 files, and successful owner/group reads.
An unrelated nobody:nogroup identity was denied before and after reboot; ACLs show other::--- throughout.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged with boot ID a59a9d9a-a5e0-44f7-9ca1-7f28483971e0; node returned with boot ID 971d7e71-4c7b-48cc-8cbd-0a7520871da9; ownership, modes, identities, hashes, and access controls recovered.
